title: First public deployment
changes: Story Studio deployed to Firebase Hosting.
Example stories open to anyone — no account needed to explore testimony or see how a story is built.
Migrated off two Gemini models Google had retired, which had silently broken summarize, timeline and story.
The app detects whether the AI service is deployed and disables those actions cleanly instead of failing one click at a time.
Fixed a caching rule that left browsers serving a stale page for an hour after each deploy.
